unit.why: A short memorate: R. Zvi fasted in order to see the deceased Maggid of Zlotshev, saw him, and heard from him about his daily ascent through the worlds.

stories.start_quote: עו״ש סיפר מורינו הנ"ל שאמר לו
stories.summary_en: R. Zvi (of Zhidachov) fasted many fasts to be granted a vision of the departed Maggid R. Yehiel Michel of Zlotshev; he saw him, and the Maggid told him that since his death he ascends daily from world to world, each higher world making yesterday's heaven seem like earth.
